description:
## X Patch 1.12.2-x.3 — image long-press URL copy

All six patches can be selected together for X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01: Fix external post links; Hide Find more; Hide Who to follow; Hide sports scores (experimental); Hide search relevance prompt (experimental); Copy media URL (image/video/GIF and video download action). Existing filters are retained. Image long-press adds a Copy media URL row without replacing native actions. The direct video/GIF MP4 URL is available from the post options action. The obsolete video downloader hook was removed because it does not match X 12.31.0. The bundle passed patch application against a real X 12.31.0 APK; on-device UI remains unverified, and video long-press is not implemented.

patches.name: Copy media URL
patches.description: Copies photo URLs from image long-press and image/video/GIF URLs from post options.

patches.name: Fix external post links
patches.description: Opens external X post URLs directly in post detail without using the For You tab.

patches.name: Hide Find more
patches.description: Hides Discover more / もっと見つける under posts and top people recommendations in Search.

patches.name: Hide Who to follow
patches.description: Hides Who to follow / recommended-account modules from timelines.

patches.name: Hide search relevance prompt
patches.description: Hides only the Is this post relevant to your search? Yes/No prompt in X Search results.

patches.name: Hide sports scores
patches.description: Experimental: hides live sports game pills at the top of X Home, preserving live-stream pills.

release_notes: Experimental five-patch Morphe bundle. Adds Hide search relevance prompt to hide the Search results yes/no survey. Preserves four previous patches. Static X 12.31/12.32 APK model evidence and CI tests pass; user device testing is pending. Existing Morphe source with prerelease toggle reads dev/patches-bundle.json. Stable main remains unchanged.
